fit: Fig fruit and gastrointestinal outcomes in a randomized IBS trial
assessment: The publisher excerpt verifies 142 completers of 150 and four withdrawals from the fig group. Fig and flixweed groups had favorable bowel symptom frequency compared with usual diet. Pain severity and C-reactive protein did not clearly differ. The registry gives 90 g fig fruit daily and the December 2018 secondary summary specifies two dried-fruit servings. The original Methods still need verification. NCT02559245 describes the same trial, with no Parkinson visual event measure.
